title: Garmin Connect
summary: Optional direct sync for what Health Connect doesn't carry.
description: Garmin Connect has Training Effect, training load, heart-rate zones, power and laps per activity, and Body Battery, stress, sleep score and HRV status per day. Tally reads them through Garmin's official Personal API.

requirements.text: Garmin Connect is reached with a Personal API key the user pastes in Settings, kept in the app's data folder and traded for short-lived tokens, or with the unofficial sign-in alone.

history.text: Garmin Connect is reached with a Personal API key the user pastes in Settings, kept in the app's data folder and traded for short-lived tokens.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: the sign-in alone can sync too.

requirements.text: An optional unofficial sign-in adds training readiness and training status for recent days.
A Garmin sync on app start or resume runs at most every `garmin.auto-sync-interval`; one started from Settings ignores that limit but not a rate-limit pause.

history.text: An automatic Garmin sync runs at most every `garmin.auto-sync-interval`; a sync started from Settings ignores that limit.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: syncs triggered by Health Connect run sooner (HD-7), and the rate-limit pause holds for manual syncs.

requirements.text: Requests to Garmin are spaced at least `garmin.request-gap` apart.
When Garmin rate-limits, syncing stops for `garmin.rate-limit-pause`.
Wellness history is backfilled one chunk per sync, back at most `garmin.backfill-max` and no further than a week before the first Garmin activity.

history.text: History is backfilled in chunks, one per sync, up to `garmin.backfill-max` back.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: only wellness history is chunked, and it stops before the first activity.

requirements.text: A Garmin activity attaches to the workout Health Connect already synced for it; an activity Health Connect doesn't have gets a workout of its own.
Activity history is read in full on the first sync.

values.description: A new workout in Health Connect triggers one after 2 minutes.
